g.text: Same one-dimensional motion: the 0.02 gap is a definitional
difference and involves no tracking error.
Layer, frame and axes must be stated
Layer values differ; local axes depend on the reference frame and
centreline, and a 2D slice omits through-plane terms.
End-systolic, peak-systolic and whole-cycle peaks diverge
Averaging before or after selecting the temporal peak gives
different values for the same field.
